title: Crokinole
description: Flick wooden discs at the 20 hole and knock your rivals into the ditch. Play against the computer, pass and play, or put the board on the TV and use phones as controllers.
thumbnailAlt: A top-down maple crokinole board with red and green discs scattered around the pegs and the centre hole, and players' names around the rail

title: League Night
description: Retro pixel disc golf at dusk: read the wind, pick your disc and angle, swipe putts at the chains, and post your round to the leaderboard.
thumbnailAlt: Three phone screens of a pixel-art disc golf game: a disc flying down a tree-lined fairway, the League Night title menu, and a behind-the-disc putting view with a power meter

title: Plague IT
description: You are the malware: start on one laptop, evolve, and take every endpoint across the USA and Canada before SecOps cleans you out.
thumbnailAlt: A dark threat map of the USA and Canada with most states and provinces glowing red, network links arcing between them and SecOps defenses listed in the corner

title: Nano Networks
description: Keep a growing company online: draw links between offices, warehouses and shops, add switches and firewalls, and survive cut cables, patch days and a DDoS before a site's queue overflows.
thumbnailAlt: A minimal network map: coloured links run from a dark HQ square out to blue office circles, orange warehouse squares and green shop triangles, with packets moving along them

title: Access Denied
description: Papers, Please on the IT service desk: verify every caller against the directory, approve or deny, and don't let the social engineer who calls every day get in.
thumbnailAlt: A Windows 95-style service desk: a caller's transcript, their ticket stamped DENIED, and the directory record showing the real spelling of their name

title: Helpdesk Survivors: Doom Mode
description: The helpdesk as a 1993-style shooter: fight through two floors of users with your IT tools, find the access badges and clock out at the exit.
thumbnailAlt: A retro first-person view down an office aisle, ticket gun in hand, with a security guard, a confused user and two managers walking up

title: Helpdesk Survivors 3D
description: The helpdesk shift rebuilt in 3D: five office floors, nineteen techs, bosses and an online leaderboard, on a phone or a computer.
thumbnailAlt: A low-poly technician in a blue polo on a 3D office floor, ringed by a crowd of office workers, with tools flying around

title: Helpdesk Survivors
description: Survive a 20-minute shift on the IT helpdesk while your tools fire on their own and the tickets swarm in.
thumbnailAlt: A pixel-art technician surrounded by office workers waving tickets on an open-plan office floor
